notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): MSUI parses the transport wire tolerantly but discards it: the GameObject create-block anchor (path-progress u32) is read and dropped (UpdateObject.cs:80), and observed movers' MOVEFLAG_ONTRANSPORT local-pose tails are read and dropped in the LIVING parse (UpdateObject.cs:49). MovementInfo.cs can carry a TransportPose for the self-player, but no timetable or keyframe evaluation exists anywhere - no TaxiPathNode/TransportAnimation loading, no per-frame cycle sampling.

notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: The stream stays in sync (all tails are consumed byte-correctly), so this is a clean feature hole rather than a parser hazard.
